items.finding: The source says product temperature measurement can be used as a PAT method to monitor a process and to obtain process parameters for in-line or off-line optimization.
items.how_it_applies: This supports considering a temperature sensor at the probe as an auxiliary input for model-based monitoring; test whether temperature measurement can be integrated at the pipe probe.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The work is on freeze-drying in a lab-scale freeze-dryer with sucrose and PVP model products, not a flowing aqueous sucrose stream in a pipe.

citation.quote: The measurement of product temperature is one of the methods that can be adopted, especially in the pharmaceutical industry, to monitor the freeze-drying process and to obtain the values of the process parameters required by mathematical models useful for in-line (or off-line) optimization.
citation.label: E05 ¶1

items.finding: The source says acid concentrations, ionic strength and temperature were varied to obtain a robust model.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests temperature should be varied or measured when building a calibration model for an in-line spectroscopic method; test temperature compensation at the probe.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source concerns nitric and hydrochloric acid and ionic strength in reactive liquid-liquid extraction, not sucrose in water or NIR transmission.

citation.quote: The concentrations of nitric acid and hydrochloric acid as well as the ionic strength and temperature were varied to obtain a robust model.
citation.label: E02 ¶19

items.finding: The source says ATR probes allow in-line measurements even in demanding environments and with highly oxidative or corrosive substances, including strong acids and bases.
items.how_it_applies: This could support testing an ATR probe for chemical compatibility with the caustic CIP fluid, but it does not establish hot-caustic CIP intervals.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The quote does not mention hot caustic, CIP cycles, cleaning intervals, sucrose, or a stainless steel pipe; it is about reaction mixtures.

citation.quote: Attenuated total reflection probes (ATR) allow in-line measurements even in demanding measurement environments and reaction mixtures with highly oxidative and corrosive substances, such as chlorosilanes or strong acids and bases.
citation.label: E01 ¶4

items.finding: The source says contamination of the probe window can prevent accurate measurement.
items.how_it_applies: This supports treating probe-window cleanliness as a risk and testing cleaning effectiveness between CIP cycles; it does not give a cleaning interval.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The contamination is from a binder in a pharmaceutical process, not hot caustic CIP or sucrose; the source does not specify probe type or cleaning interval.

citation.quote: However, an accurate measurement may not be possible because of contamination of the probe window due to the addition of a binder during the process, which is a disadvantage.
citation.label: E03 ¶27
